cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

mechanism: A controls the accounting of fault, disclosing A portion first and defining B reciprocal admission as the remaining required piece.
confusable: Distinguish general confession from using each admitted fragment to put a specific burden of reciprocal disclosure on B.
comparison: Meeting failure assigns missing time/room halves; complaint letters move from singular hidden letter to a jointly ordered series.
seedUse: Canonical time/room and letter seeds already let A direct completion of the account; S01 in assigning halves and ordering disclosure, not just prefacing.
